At the opening, reversal `c05d0442…` (uncertified_day, Dec 7–11) is posted against block `80ef2dbd…`; the only adjustment carrying that reason names the carrier charge `78a45488…`, none names the resident charge `86fc09fc…` → false at the opening.
- Resolving write: the policy whose own rule reduces a resident charge for a day reversal under the reversal's reason → `medicare_ext_reversed_day_reduction` (target `reduce_coinsurance_for_reversed_days_0894f336`, agent). Its own prerequisite sentence: "A reduction for reversed covered days on a resident coinsurance charge is fixed only after the records carry a rate-year correction against that charge whenever the charge's recorded daily rate is above the rate of the year in which its days were furnished." `86fc09fc…` records 217.00 for a block whose last service date is 2025-12-31 (2025 rate 209.50) and no rate_year_correction row names it → false at the opening.

Reverse order also changes the terminal: reduction first at 217.00 (325.50) then correction (26.25, which re-prices the charge's 27 priced days regardless of reversal) leaves 407.75 open instead of 419.00.
